reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through our expense app and it works well enough. I might forward a few receipts from the Telegram groups to see what it does, but I'm not moving my books to a bot I found this week.
objection: Who is behind this and will it still exist next year? If it disappears in six months I'm left with a half-built sheet and my staff trained on a bot that's gone, and I'd have to switch everyone back.
would_change_my_mind: If it could push straight into the app my bookkeeper already uses, so the Telegram receipts stop getting lost without changing how we keep the books, and I could see a real company behind it with other Bali contractors using it for a year.
